business_summary: Bushiroad Inc. engages in the entertainment business in Japan, the United States, Asia, and internationally. It is also involved in the planning, development, production, and sale of trading card and digital games; planning, creation, and production of comics and anime programs; the planning and production of music content and pro-wrestling events; and the operation of a voice actor office, as well as merchandising and advertising agency businesses. In addition, the company provides Bushiroad Main IP and TCG products, including CardFight!! Vanguard, Weiß Schwarz, BanG Dream!, Revue Starlight, and STARDOM; organizes trading card game tournaments and events; and develops and releases trading card game supplies, such as card sleeves and rubber playmats. Further, it plans, manages, and distributes mobile online, and console games; offers music software, such as music CDs, live and stage videos, and Blu-ray theatrical versions; and manages live music and music-related events, live viewing, and online streaming, as well as stage production. Additionally, the company creates and distributes character goods to toy stores, general retailers, and hobby shops; provides capsule toys, prizes, and promotional events; sells goods through Bushiroad Global Online Store; and develops and provides concert merchandise, which includes light sticks, t-shirts, and towels, as well as voice actor goods and arcade prizes. Bushiroad Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Nakano, Japan.
